page.content:
Tiefling cleric of the Traveler and the Nein's bright chaos.

How Jester Lavorre connects

  • Faction: Mighty Nein — Jester Lavorre is the Traveler cleric of the Mighty Nein.
  • Character: Laura Bailey — Laura Bailey plays Jester Lavorre.

What is Jester Lavorre?

Jester Lavorre is Laura Bailey's Campaign 2 cleric, the sapphire tiefling from Nicodranas whose Traveler faith, pastries, and sketches pull the Mighty Nein together.

Key threads lead to Mighty Nein and Laura Bailey.
